tokens.name: pl-navy

tokens.name: pl-deep

tokens.name: pl-gold-ink

tokens.name: pl-sage
tokens.usage: Progress bars, 'handed in', approved, the avatar disc.

tokens.name: pl-risk
tokens.usage: Rejected / not working / reject buttons only — never decorative.

tokens.name: pl-ai
tokens.usage: The AI accent. Only where an AI speaks (V2+): AI-drafted items, the companion's glow. Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: pl-paper
tokens.usage: Opaque paper: hybrid cards, solid fallbacks.

tokens.name: pl-page
tokens.usage: Pulse warm white — the light and hybrid page ground.

tokens.name: pl-line
tokens.usage: Hairline divider on paper (hybrid).

tokens.name: pl-line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger divider / well edge on paper.

tokens.name: pl-lt-ink
tokens.usage: Text on navy/glass (sidebar, hero, dark theme): ≥4.9:1 at the worst ground pixel.

tokens.name: pl-lt-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy/glass: ≥4.3:1 worst case — keep it 12.5px+ medium or larger.

tokens.name: pl-bg
tokens.usage: The page ground's base colour.

tokens.name: pl-ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on the page ground: 14.2:1 light, ≥5:1 dark.

tokens.name: pl-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary/meta text on the page ground: ≥4.5:1 light (worst orb), ≥4.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: pl-surface
tokens.usage: Card fill: frosted white (light, blur 16px), paper (hybrid), glass tier 2 (dark, blur 20px).

tokens.name: pl-surface-edge
tokens.usage: Card edge at rest — always drawn; a translucent fill can't carry its own boundary.

tokens.name: pl-surface-edge-hover
tokens.usage: Card edge while hovered (link cards, choices).

tokens.name: pl-surface-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside a card: ≥12:1 light/hybrid, ≥5:1 dark.

tokens.name: pl-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text inside a card.

tokens.name: pl-chrome
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar fill (blur 20px). Dark is a scrim: content scrolls under it.

tokens.name: pl-rail
tokens.usage: Sidebar fill: smoked navy glass (light), deep navy with its own glows (hybrid), glass tier (dark).

tokens.name: pl-panel
tokens.usage: Hero / context panel fill — the 'live' panel at the top of a workspace.

tokens.name: pl-well
tokens.usage: Input and recessed-area fill at rest (with an inner shadow).

tokens.name: pl-well-edge
tokens.usage: Input edge — the strong edge on dark, because a control must read at 3:1.

tokens.name: pl-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px; #9eeaf5 inside the sidebar/hero of every theme.

tokens.name: pl-grid-minor
tokens.usage: Graph-paper grid, 44px pitch.

tokens.name: pl-grid-major
tokens.usage: Major grid line every 176px (light only).
